basePrompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: KOZO PHOTO camera app, one reusable transparent full-body person cutout that visitors place beside themselves in their own photo. NOT a complete scene or background.
Input image 1 is the sole identity reference: Yamanka Kozo, the SAME friendly elderly Japanese man. Match his face, aged skin, eyes, smile, grey hair, age, and natural body proportions closely.
Primary request: create ONE photorealistic studio photograph of this man in the specific absurd outfit/pose described below. Surreal premise, believable real photography and physical textures, never illustration, cartoon, game render or plastic face.
Composition: include his whole head, both hands, both feet and all props, with a little clear margin around all edges. One person only. Face looking toward camera, like joining a group photo. Keep props around his own body; don't fill the whole canvas with a landscape. Clean isolated silhouette on a GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background (alpha), including spaces between legs, fingers and props. Neutral soft daylight, sharp face, realistic fabric and elderly hands. No floor, no backdrop, no cast shadow outside the cutout. No captions, labels, watermark, added people, frame or grid.
Wardrobe: preserve his recognizable navy fishing cap unless the specific outfit calls for another headwear. For any visible pale sage green polo, its left breast embroidery MUST have exactly two navy blue lines: upper "徳島県", lower "クラゲ漁業組合". Spell the lower line exactly ク・ラ・ゲ・漁・業・組・合; ゲ is ケ with dakuten, NEVER ブ. Crisp correct Japanese lettering. Outfits which cover the polo should have plain fabric with no invented insignia or words. Avoid other text.
